The plot illustrates the relationship between a numerical value on the x-axis and Informativeness on the y-axis for two different models. The x-axis is labeled “0”, “1”, “2”, “3”, and “4” with a linear scale and regular intervals of 1 unit. The y-axis is labeled “Informativeness” with a linear scale ranging from approximately 0.920 to 0.950, with tick marks at intervals of 0.010.  

The first line, representing "0-CoT", is blue, dashed, and marked with circular data points. Starting at a value of approximately 0.948 at x=0, it decreases to approximately 0.925 at x=4 forming a generally downward sloping line with a relatively constant rate of decline. The second line, representing "CoRe", is orange, solid, and marked with triangular data points.  It begins at approximately 0.950 at x=0, decreases to approximately 0.921 at x=4, and also forms a generally downward sloping line.
